title: Atlas & Provenance
subtitle: Look at the shipped atlas pages, pack into staging and compare byte by byte with the shipped atlas, export for game engines, and read where every asset came from.

budget.intro: Shipped pages, pixels and bytes of each chunk against its ceiling in the {profile} profile. “If staged were packed” packs the frames agents submitted for assets that have no processed frames yet, without writing anything.
budget.noCeiling: This set has no per-chunk ceiling in the project; the numbers are what is shipped.
budget.whatif.none: No assets are staged for this chunk: every asset with frames already has processed frames. Packing would change nothing.
budget.whatif.intro: {n} asset(s) have only staged frames. Packing them would add {frames} frame(s):
pack.intro: Pack {target} into a staging directory and compare it with the shipped atlas, file by file. Nothing is written to a shipped atlas.
pack.explain: Three levels: identical (the same bytes), equivalent (same layout, same JSON bytes, every pixel the same; only the compressed PNG bytes differ because Node's zlib is not the one the shipped PNGs were written with), and differs (something real changed). The project's own packer is the byte authority: run it into staging to compare byte for byte.
pack.pickChunk: Pick a chunk on the left to pack it.
pack.studio.text: Packs with this studio's own packer: the same layout rules as the project packer, the same JSON text, pixel-identical pages.
pack.studio.check: Also ask the project's own check to accept the staged pages
pack.studio.unavailable: This set has no processed directory in the pack, so this studio cannot rebuild it.
pack.authority.text: Runs the project's registered packer into staging. Its output is the byte reference.
pack.authority.button: Run the project packer into staging
pack.authority.noToolchain: The registered interpreter or program is not present on this machine.
pack.authority.notRegistered: The pack registers no packer for this set.
pack.authority.ran: The project packer ran in {ms} ms.
pack.verdict.identical.text: {engine}: every file is byte for byte the same as the shipped one.
pack.verdict.equivalent.text: {engine}: same layout, same JSON bytes, every pixel the same. Only the compressed PNG bytes differ (see the files below).
pack.verdict.differs.text: {engine}: the staged atlas is not the shipped one. The first difference is named below.
pack.check.ok: The project's check accepted the staged pages: {output}
pack.check.failed: The project's check rejected the staged pages: {output}
pack.check.none: The pack registers no check for this set.
pack.profile.counts: {identical} identical · {equivalent} equivalent · {differs} differ · {not_produced} not produced here
pack.notProduced: This studio does not write this file type; only the project packer does.
pack.unchanged: the shipped atlas directories were fingerprinted before and after and did not change ({fingerprint}…)
diff.pngHash: only the SHA-256 of a page PNG differs ({path}), which follows from the PNG bytes
diff.pngBytes: same size and every pixel the same; the compressed stream differs (the shipped PNG was written by Pillow's zlib-ng, Node uses its own zlib)
diff.missing_staged: the shipped file has no staged counterpart
diff.extra_staged: there is no shipped file to compare with
export.intro: Write {target} ({profile} profile) in the formats below into an export staging directory. Shipped atlases are only read.
export.where: Files go to the export staging directory, never to a shipped atlas.

ledger.rules.title: Art-bible version
ledger.rules.line: Rules version {version}: {current} asset(s) made under it, {stale} made under an older version, {unstamped} made before stamps existed.
ledger.rules.note: The version is a hash of the palette, the outline and alpha rule, the size classes and the proportions. When it changes the studio only counts what is stale; it regenerates nothing unless a person asks. Assets without a stamp are not stale and their records are untouched.
ledger.handoff.title: Handoff package
ledger.handoff.intro: Builds a folder in staging with each asset's provenance file, the ledger and drafted disclosure text for Steam and itch.io. It is blocked while an asset's recorded output licence does not match the licence profile the project states. Nothing is published or uploaded: you do that.
ledger.handoff.noProfile: The project states no licence profile, so output licences could not be checked. A person must decide.
ledger.handoff.unrecorded: {n} asset(s) have provenance but no recorded output licence. A person decides whether that is acceptable.
ledger.handoff.created: Written to staging: {dir} ({files} files). Nothing was published.
ledger.fields.title: Origin fields: what is known
ledger.fields.intro: For every asset each origin field is either recorded, checked and unknown, not applicable, or the asset is only planned. "Never checked" should stay at 0.
